The last solar eclipse before the year 2000 was a **total solar eclipse** on **August 11, 1999**.

This eclipse was one of the most widely viewed in human history, as its path of totality crossed over densely populated areas of Europe and Asia, including the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Austria, Hungary, Romania, and Turkey.
